title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 4th Proof The Consensus Of The Prophets

questions.question: According to the passage, how does the agreement of the prophets support this person’s mission?
questions.answer: Their shared witness supports both Allah’s oneness and the truth that he is a real messenger.

questions.question: What reason is given for saying the prophets’ agreement is strong evidence?
questions.answer: The signs that prove prophethood in earlier prophets were also found in him in a complete way, as history shows.

questions.question: Which earlier scriptures are said to contain announcements about his coming?
questions.answer: The Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: Besides spoken predictions, what else from the prophets is presented as support for his mission?
questions.answer: Their actions and miracles are described as confirming his mission as well.

questions.question: What idea is expressed by saying they “signed” his mission, in a manner of speaking?
questions.answer: It means their lives and prophetic works served as a clear endorsement of his message.

questions.question: What is special about his role among the prophets in the passage?
questions.answer: He is presented as the leading and most complete one in carrying out prophetic duties.

questions.question: In the fifth section, who are the next group that testify in his favor?
questions.answer: The saints who reached truth and spiritual perfection by following his teaching.

questions.question: What did these saints attain through following him?
questions.answer: They gained truth, spiritual realization, maturity, extraordinary spiritual gifts, unveiling, and direct witnessing.

questions.question: What two major truths do these saints testify to unanimously?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness and his truthfulness as a messenger.

questions.question: How do the saints strengthen their testimony about the unseen matters he taught?
questions.answer: They witness some of those realities through sainthood and affirm all of them through faith with different levels of certainty.

questions.question: What are the three levels of certainty mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Certainty through knowledge, certainty through direct seeing, and complete certainty.

questions.question: What overall conclusion did the traveler reach from the witness of the prophets and saints?
questions.answer: He understood that these united testimonies clearly show this person’s honesty, uprightness, and true messengerhood.

questions.question: How is the prophets’ agreement connected to belief in Allah?
questions.answer: Their agreement supports not only his mission but also the existence and oneness of Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what common features did the earlier prophets and this being share?
questions.answer: They shared sacred qualities, miracles, and prophetic responsibilities that point to true prophethood.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention history?
questions.answer: To show that the prophetic signs found in earlier messengers were also present in him in a well-attested way.

questions.question: What is the difference between the prophets’ spoken agreement and the agreement shown through their deeds?
questions.answer: Their spoken agreement appears in their predictions, while their deeds and miracles support him through practical confirmation.

questions.question: In the fifth section, why are saints treated as important witnesses?
questions.answer: Because they reached high spiritual states by learning from him and following his path.

questions.question: How do these saints know that some of the unseen truths he taught are real?
questions.answer: They experience some of them through spiritual illumination and witnessing.

questions.question: Do the saints affirm only part of what he taught about the unseen or all of it?
questions.answer: They directly witness some of it and believe in all of it.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about the relationship between following him and reaching spiritual perfection?
questions.answer: It presents following him as the path through which saints reached those high states.

questions.question: What comparison is used to describe how clearly the saints’ witness proves his truthfulness?
questions.answer: It is described as being as clear and obvious as the sun.

questions.question: What shared pattern appears in both the fourth and fifth sections?
questions.answer: A whole group with recognized authority gives united testimony that he is truthful and truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: Name the two groups whose testimony is discussed in the target passage.
questions.answer: The prophets and the saints.

questions.question: What does the prophets’ testimony prove about this being?
questions.answer: It proves that he is truthful and that he truly carries the mission of a messenger.

questions.question: Why is the testimony of all prophets especially weighty in the passage?
questions.answer: Because they are already established as true messengers, so their united witness carries great authority.

questions.question: How did earlier prophets reportedly point to his coming in words?
questions.answer: They gave advance news and glad tidings about him in earlier revealed books.

questions.question: How did they support him through actions, not just words?
questions.answer: Their prophetic works and miracles are described as confirming his mission.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest by calling his mission the most complete in prophetic work?
questions.answer: It suggests that his mission stands at the highest level in fulfilling the purpose of prophethood.

questions.question: Who are described as having reached high spiritual ranks by means of his teaching?
questions.answer: Thousands of saints.

questions.question: What kinds of spiritual attainments are listed for these saints?
questions.answer: Real truth, spiritual realization, maturity, extraordinary acts, inner unveiling, and witnessing.

questions.question: What does their experience of unseen truths imply about his message?
questions.answer: It implies that what he taught about unseen realities is trustworthy and true.

questions.question: How does the passage combine spiritual experience and faith in the saints’ testimony?
questions.answer: They personally perceive some truths spiritually and accept the rest with strong faith and certainty.

questions.question: What can be inferred about the saints’ view of him as their master?
questions.answer: They saw him as the highest guide whose truthfulness was undeniable.

questions.question: If someone asked for two independent lines of evidence from this passage alone, what would they be?
questions.answer: The united witness of the prophets and the united witness of the saints.

questions.question: What role do revealed books play in the argument?
questions.answer: They are presented as written places where earlier prophets foretold his coming.

questions.question: Why does the passage say more than twenty examples were presented elsewhere?
questions.answer: To show that the claim of prediction is not vague but supported with multiple detailed cases.

questions.question: What is meant by saying the prophets agreed through their deeds?
questions.answer: Their miracles and prophetic actions pointed in the same direction and backed his mission.

questions.question: What conclusion did the traveler draw from the prophets’ united witness?
questions.answer: He understood that their agreement supports this being’s truthfulness.

questions.question: In the fifth section, what makes the saints’ testimony different from the prophets’ testimony?
questions.answer: The prophets testify as earlier messengers, while the saints testify as followers who reached spiritual certainty through his guidance.

questions.question: How is following him linked to the saints’ achievements?
questions.answer: Their spiritual growth and insight came through learning from him and walking in his way.

questions.question: What is the importance of the “World of the Unseen” in this section?
questions.answer: It is the area where some of his teachings were spiritually confirmed by the saints.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention different degrees of certainty?
questions.answer: To show that the saints’ faith is not shallow; it reaches increasingly stronger levels of assurance.

questions.question: What do both sections say about unanimity?
questions.answer: They present unanimous agreement as a powerful proof of truth.

questions.question: How would you summarize the logical flow from prophets to saints?
questions.answer: First, earlier prophets point to him and confirm him; then later saints follow him and verify his teachings through lived spiritual experience.

questions.question: What final judgment about him is strengthened by both groups together?
questions.answer: That he is completely truthful, upright, and truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: What is one major proof given from earlier revelation for this being’s mission?
questions.answer: Earlier revealed scriptures are said to contain predictions and glad tidings about him.

questions.question: What is another major proof given from the prophets besides scripture?
questions.answer: Their miracles and prophetic activity are presented as supporting his mission.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect the prophets’ witness to Allah’s unity and also to this being’s mission?
questions.answer: Because the same prophets who call people to Allah also confirm the messenger who came in continuity with them.

questions.question: What does the passage say existed in him “in full measure” compared with other prophets?
questions.answer: The qualities, signs, and duties that indicate genuine prophethood.

questions.question: What kind of people are the saints described as being?
questions.answer: People who reached truth, reality, perfection, and advanced spiritual insight.

questions.question: How did these saints reach those states?
questions.answer: By learning from this being and following him.

questions.question: What do the saints witness directly, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Some of the unseen truths he taught.

questions.question: What do they accept through faith even beyond what they directly witness?
questions.answer: They affirm all the truths he proclaimed.

questions.question: How strong is their certainty presented as being?
questions.answer: It ranges from learned certainty to direct certainty and then to the highest complete certainty.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about a message that produces many truthful saints?
questions.answer: It implies that the message itself is true and that its teacher is trustworthy.

questions.question: Why is the saints’ testimony compared to sunlight?
questions.answer: To show that its clarity and force are very strong and hard to deny.

questions.question: What is the best brief summary of the target passage?
questions.answer: It argues that both the earlier prophets and the later saints unanimously confirm the truthfulness and messengerhood of this being.

questions.question: Which section of the target passage focuses on prophets, and which focuses on saints?
questions.answer: The fourth section focuses on prophets, and the fifth section focuses on saints.

questions.question: What does the prophets’ consensus function as in the argument?
questions.answer: It functions as solid evidence for his honesty and prophetic mission.

questions.question: In what two forms is the prophets’ support described?
questions.answer: In spoken prediction and in practical confirmation through their deeds and miracles.

questions.question: Why are the earlier scriptures important in this discussion?
questions.answer: They show that his coming was announced before him in recognized revealed texts.

questions.question: What title or role is implied for him when the passage says he is foremost in prophetic tasks?
questions.answer: He is portrayed as the leading and most complete messenger in carrying out prophetic work.

questions.question: What sort of community gives testimony in the fifth section?
questions.answer: A large body of saints shaped by his teaching and example.

questions.question: What does their unanimity add to the argument?
questions.answer: It adds a later, experience-based confirmation from people known for spiritual depth.

questions.question: How do these saints relate to truths about the unseen?
questions.answer: They spiritually perceive some of them and firmly believe all of them.

questions.question: What does the phrase about “light” suggest in their testimony?
questions.answer: It suggests that their knowledge comes through spiritual illumination and deep faith, not mere guesswork.

questions.question: What can be inferred from the saints’ different levels of certainty?
questions.answer: Their affirmation is grounded and mature, with evidence appropriate to each degree of certainty.

questions.question: What did the traveler recognize from all this testimony?
questions.answer: He recognized that the great being’s truthfulness and straightness were clearly established.

questions.question: How do the fourth and fifth sections work together as one argument?
questions.answer: One brings the witness of the prophets before him, and the other brings the witness of the saints after him, so both past and later testimony support his mission.
